description: 本轮已授权研究的有界旧用途核对；不注册模型、不修改源码。完整程序在执行前保存。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,re
ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_dr007_transaction_amount_history_acquisition_v1'
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def read(rel):return json.loads((ROOT/rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save_new(name,obj):
 p=OUT/name
 assert not p.exists(),'已经存在，不覆盖：'+name
 p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
rels=[
'research/manufacturing_price_transmission_daily_v1.py',
'reports/research/510300_manufacturing_price_transmission_daily_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_manufacturing_price_transmission_daily_v1/result.json',
'reports/research/510300_manufacturing_price_transmission_source_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_historical_price_gap_causes_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_historical_price_gap_causes_v1/result.json',
'research/macro_transmission_context_v4.py',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/result.json',
'reports/research/510300_export_order_cause_increment_v1/result.json']
parents=[{'path':s,'sha256':sha(ROOT/s)} for s in rels]
daily=read(rels[1]);old=read(rels[2]);gap=read(rels[4]);gapresult=read(rels[5])
source=(ROOT/rels[0]).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
match=re.search(r'^FEATURE\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"',source,re.M)
assert match and match.group(1)=='output_minus_input_diffusion_pp'
assert daily['feature']==match.group(1)
assert old['status']=='FROZEN_NO_QUALIFIED_MANUFACTURING_PRICE_TRANSMISSION_STRATEGY'
assert gapresult['status']=='HISTORICAL_EVENT_DIAGNOSTIC_NO_STANDALONE_EDGE_ESTABLISHED'
record={
'checked_at':now(),
'status':'COMPLETED_LIMITED_OLD_MANUFACTURING_PRICE_USE_REVIEW_NO_NEW_MODEL_REGISTERED',
'parents':parents,
'proposed_local_fallback':'采购与出厂价格分项配合订单背景，能否成为不同的日频联合条件信息。',
'old_daily_use':{'feature':daily['feature'],'models':daily['models'],'training':daily['training'],'primary_status':old['status'],'primary_saved_sharpe':old['primary']['sharpe'],'primary_saved_cagr':old['primary']['annual_return'],'new_result':False},
'old_component_cause_use':{'question':gap['question'],'new_information_relative_to_old_study':gap['new_information_relative_to_old_study'],'order_confirmation':gap['order_confirmation'],'status':gapresult['status'],'events':gapresult['historical_events'],'primary_events':gapresult['primary_events'],'key_findings':gapresult['key_findings']},
'other_descriptive_use':'macro_transmission_context_v4已经联接input_price_diffusion、output_price_diffusion、output_minus_input_diffusion_pp；其观察状态不自动成为获准的新交易模型。',
'decision':'本轮未建立足以新增经济候选的实质不同原因信息；不因DR访问缺口将旧分项/订单解释换成日频或非线性模型重开。没有宣称所有价格分项组合已经被穷尽，也不把旧特定表达失败概括为制造业信息永久无效。',
'new_absolute_level_candidate':'未登记、未准入、未拟合；本次没有为其建立不同用途合同或新的上游原因证据。',
'does_not_reject_unobserved_dr007_amount_hypothesis':True,
'new_study_registered':False,
'new_source_requests':0,'new_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,
'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET',
'bounded_review_not_whole_repository_exhaustion_proof':True}
save_new('本地制造业价格候选_旧用途核对与不重开裁决.json',record)
report=[
'# 当前访问缺口与本地候选：补充结论','',
'用户回复“暂时没有”有效Tushare或项目代理访问，已保存直接答复。本轮不重复请求到期运输、不购买服务；成交额历史仍未取得，相关经济假设尚未检验，并未被数据结果否定。','',
'本地data/curated有界检查了五个现有利率流动性表，未发现同DR007成交额历史；央行逆回购操作量描述操作投放，不能代替银行间成交额。该有限检查不证明全仓或所有公开来源都没有相应数据。','',
'旧日历研究已经包含月末/季末、剩余天数和非线性模型。制造业旧日频账户只使用出厂减购进价差，后续历史解释又拆分采购/出厂变化及订单确认；没有建立足够不同的新原因信息，当前不把这些旧用途重新包装为新模型。所有价格分项组合未被本次穷尽，旧失败也不是整个信息家族永久无效的证明。','',
'本补充核对新增拟合、标签、账户和源码修改均为0。E33实际提供方请求为0；净夏普NOT_COMPUTED，总目标未达。已有账户、冻结参数、风险门和已失败方向保持。','',
'E34只在真实有效访问更新或取得同身份可靠历史序列后另注册收件；当前未注册，无活进程、无自动轮询。完整原训练/决定日支持与成交额公开时钟、数值版本通过后，才能另注册一次原参数联合评分。当前没有新策略获准或已经运行。','',
'[用户答复](用户访问答复_事实.json)、[本地五表](本地其他利率流动性数据_有限字段清单.json)、[日历旧用途](本地日历候选_旧用途核对与不重开裁决.json)、[制造业旧用途](本地制造业价格候选_旧用途核对与不重开裁决.json)、[E33实际结果](result.json)。']
p=OUT/'访问缺口与本地候选_补充结论.md'
assert not p.exists()
p.write_text('\n'.join(report)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
for p in parents:assert sha(ROOT/p['path'])==p['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'旧用途核对':'已结束','新研究登记':False,'新拟合':0,'新账户':0,'源码修改':0,'DR成交额假设':'尚未检验'},ensure_ascii=False))
